feeds.title: Tech Savvy Mama
feeds.description: I'm the founder of the award-winning tech-savvy mama, a site that since 2008, has been helping parents navigate parenting in the digital age. I've combined my knowledge of child development, psychology, education, tech and parenting to provide useful advice for families about digital parenting topics since 2008.

feeds.title: Techie Homeschool Mom Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Sara, a teacher-turned-homeschool-mom who loves the benefits a balanced approach to technology can bring to homeschooling. My goal is to inspire and equip you to add valuable digital learning experiences to your homeschool.

feeds.title: BostonTechMom Blog
feeds.description: Resource for parents who want to inspire children with science, technology, engineering, and math (STEM) learning. Cyndi Reitmeyer, the founder of BostonTechMom, connects parents with high-quality STEM programs that expose kids to technology in a fun, meaningful, and engaging ways.

feeds.title: Techie Mamma Blog
feeds.description: Learn how to build and grow your business website along with hacks and tricks to manage this wonderful Mompreneur Life. I am Cousett. I teach DIY mompreneurs how to maximize technology through tech coaching.

feeds.title: Little Tech Girl
feeds.description: I'm Kris McDonald. Born and raised in Chicago, I'm a mom raising 2 sets of twins. I caught the technology bug early on, and I've been dabbling in what I love ever since. I blog about tech stuff! Ok, not only tech stuff but mostly tech stuff! As I grow and my interest expands, so has my content in other topics like lifestyle, gardening, hydroponics, smart home gadgets, home design, and travel.

feeds.title: Digital Mom Blog
feeds.description: Covers articles about technology, parenting, mom life, and lots of funny memes. Whether you are a mom looking to read the Woahs of parenting, want to be in the know about the latest in mom technology, watch a review of a cool gadget, impress your kids with Minecraft facts, learn about sleep training toddlers with a kids alarm clock or just enjoy fun geekery links - this is a website that has it. We talk tech, laugh at funny memes and discuss all things about mom life.

feeds.title: Michigan Mama News » Techy Moms
feeds.description: This section is exclusively dedicated to the technology used and reviewed by moms. Michigan Mama News (and Dads too!) is an online blog magazine serving Michigan families and beyond in the areas of fun Michigan news, recipes, wellness, homeschool, travel, arts and crafts, reviews, giveaways, and MORE!

feeds.title: Sunshine and Hurricanes » Technology
feeds.description: Educating parents about today's technology, so they can raise kids who stay safe and make smart choices in all areas of their connected lives.

feeds.title: Mom Does Reviews » Technology
feeds.description: Pam Maynard, owner and creator or Mom Does Reviews- the sweet stuff of life, loves to blog about anything that makes our lives easier, happier and sweeter. MDR loves sharing recipes and crafts for your kids! Pam does product reviews you can trust like toys, clothes, food, travel, movies and more. Browse through reviews of all things technology including tips and advice.

feeds.title: Cool Mom Tech
feeds.description: Cool Mom Tech is the top parents' resource for tech tips, social media help + non-alarmist guidance for raising kids smartly and safely in the digital age.

feeds.title: Family Tech Zone
feeds.description: NBC, CBS, and Fox News Family Tech Expert, Sarah Kimmel, brings you news, tips & How-to's to help you understand and manage technology in your home.

feeds.title: Mom Tech Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I am Jen - a mom, writer, and spent over sixteen years working in an Information and Technology career. I started this site to write about my other passion, technology! Join along as I review new tech, apps, social media, and anything else tech and parenting-related. I try to keep a special focus on how technology affects our children.

feeds.title: Moms With Apps Blog
feeds.description: A blog supporting the thoughtful use of technology with a family-friendly point of view.

feeds.title: Carley K.
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Carley- mom of two, taco enthusiast, and your friend in technology. When I'm not on the Today Show or working with HGTV, I'm writing about how we can all make more mindful use of our tech, and make more meaningful connections in a hyperconnected world.

feeds.title: The Cyber Safety Tech Mum
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Nicolle. My goal is to impart information (including my own experiences) and practical steps that you can take to increase your child's safety when they are online and help them to become responsible digital citizens. I am dedicated to ensuring that information is shared in bite-sized portions and in everyday language so that you don't feel overwhelmed and that you are kept up-to-date with current trends.

feeds.title: Tech Lovin' Mom
feeds.description: My name is Amanda and I LOVE all things related to technology. Let Tech Lovin' Mom help you navigate the world of technology to find the best products to enhance your life.

feeds.title: The Online Mom
feeds.description: Founded by parents with extensive technology backgrounds, The Online Mom is an organization and website devoted to providing the knowledge, advice, and tools that will help all parents protect their kids and encourage responsible behavior as they make the most of the new digital world.

feeds.title: Afropolitan Mom » Technology
feeds.description: Afropolitan Mom is an award-winning women's lifestyle blog. Find the latest tech, travel, fashion tips, recipes for your family.

feeds.title: TechCommGeekMom
feeds.description: Musings and learning about technical communications issues from your TechCommGeekMom - a geeky mom who is into tech comm, since 2012.

feeds.title: NYC Tech Mommy
feeds.description: Inspiring families to live simple, live fun, and live life by sharing family lifestyle, tech and travel. Author Monica Encarnacion is born and raised in New Yorker, former educator, Latina, and mommy of two.

feeds.title: WanderWoMom » Technology
feeds.description: This section of WanderWoMom is dedicated to Technology. Margaux shares with us some snippets of her wonders, one plane ride at a time. She became WanderWoMom (Est 2012) when she was pregnant with her son, Coco. From stories of her travels and whatnot, along came motherhood stories, (mis)adventures and everything in between, with a cherry on top.

feeds.title: Low Tech Grandma Blog
feeds.description: This Low-Tech Grandma is feeling her way through the various technological gadgets and services. Gone are the days of rotary phones and manual typewriters. Now it's all about mobile phones, streaming TV, and Bluetooth keyboards. This blog is where she gets to write about the technological advances of yesterday. As she goes through and discovers things she writes about them.

feeds.title: Techmomogy
feeds.description: I'm Nicole! I'm a former engineer turned Brand & Web Developer. I own Squishy Creative, LLC, manage social media for multiple clients, and homeschool my 2 boys, Cole & Dean. I'm married to a brilliant, Jeff. I started Techmomogy in 2010 as a new mom and tech freak.
